name: conventional-commit-panel
description: Compose Conventional Commit messages from a persistent panel in the Source Control view.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Repository JavaScript commit configs (.cz-config.js, commitlint.config.js) are not executed in untrusted workspaces; built-in commit types are used instead.

conventionalCommitPanel.liveSync.description: Continuously write the composed message into the Source Control input box as you edit fields. The extension never creates the commit itself — you still press Commit.

conventionalCommitPanel.headerMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the commit header (type, scope and subject). Overridden by a commitlint 'header-max-length' rule when one is found.

conventionalCommitPanel.bodyLineLength.description: Wrap the commit body at this column. Set to 0 to disable wrapping.

conventionalCommitPanel.useEmoji.description: Prefix the commit subject with the emoji associated with the selected type.

conventionalCommitPanel.types.markdownDescription: Commit types to offer. When empty, types are taken from the repository config (`.cz-config.js`, `.czrc`, commitlint) or the built-in Conventional Commits list.

value.description: The type written into the commit message, e.g. 'feat'.

name.description: Label shown in the picker. Defaults to the value.

description.description: Longer explanation shown as the picker detail.

emoji.description: Emoji used when conventionalCommitPanel.useEmoji is enabled.

conventionalCommitPanel.scope.ticketPatt.markdownDescription: Regular expression used to pull a ticket ID out of the branch name, e.g. `feature/PROJ-123-add-login` → `PROJ-123`. The first capture group is used when present.

conventionalCommitPanel.scope.branchPref.description: Branch name prefixes stripped before falling back to the branch segment as a scope.

conventionalCommitPanel.scope.required.markdownDescription: Treat an empty scope as an error. Conventional Commits makes the scope optional, so this is off by default; turn it on to block committing until a scope is set.

conventionalCommitPanel.showBreakingChan.markdownDescription: Show the breaking-change toggle. It adds a `!` marker and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, which release tooling reads as a major version bump — turn it off in repositories that do not publish versioned packages.

conventionalCommitPanel.showCustomType.description: Show a Custom card at the end of the type grid for typing a type that is not on the list. A repository that pins its types with a commitlint type-enum rule will still report a custom type as invalid.

conventionalCommitPanel.scope.ignoreBran.description: Branches whose name is not filled into the scope automatically. They are still offered as a suggestion chip — this only stops a long-lived branch name like main landing in a commit by itself.

conventionalCommitPanel.config.allowJsCo.markdownDescription: Allow loading JavaScript commit configs (`.cz-config.js`, `commitlint.config.js`) from the repository. These are executed in a short-lived child process. JSON and YAML configs are always read and never executed.

conventionalCommitPanel.body.useEditor.description: Always edit the commit body in a full editor tab instead of a single-line input box.

scripts.verify: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm test && npm run compile && npm run test:integration && npm run package
